text: The Na+/H+ exchanger NHE6 was selectively downregulated in ApoE4 brain and astrocytes, which the authors propose causes the endosomal hyperacidification.
description: ApoE4 brain tissue and astrocytes; species (human vs ApoE-TR mouse), age and assay not specified. Abstract-only. Caveat: the system is unclear, possibly not human non-aged cells.

provenance.excerpt: Hyperacidification of endosomal pH is caused by selective down regulation of the Na  + /H  + exchanger NHE6, which functions as a critical proton leak pathway, in ApoE4 brain and astrocytes.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower NHE6 expression in brain and astrocytes) -> (reduced endosomal proton leak) -> (lower endosomal pH)

measured.variable: NHE6 (SLC9A6) expression, a proton leak pathway proposed to set endosomal pH
